subject: cardboardRobot
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: kid in a cardboard-box robot costume.
Style: cardboard craft.

requests.what: A handmade cardboard robot light bar across the helmet roof: a narrow kraft housing, two folded brackets, and six tiny lamps alternating CYAN and MAGENTA. Keep the lamps bright and toy-like.
A bent cardboard antenna on the helmet's upper left: two short square stalk segments, a red ball tip, and a little folded base collar.
A raised shield-shaped cardboard chest emblem with a dark outline, a bold lightning-bolt symbol, and two tiny folded corner tabs. Use BLUE, KRAFT_HIGHLIGHT, and EDGE.
Two chunky three-finger cardboard claw hands, mirrored left and right. Each finger is a tapered folded tab with dark edge faces, leaving a small gap between digits.
Mirrored knee armour plates on both knees: small angled kraft plates with alternating RED and KRAFT_DARK warning chevrons and two cardboard rivets.
A compact square cardboard power backpack behind the torso, with a central raised box, two side vents, a top handle, and three dangling insulated cables in RED, BLUE, and KRAFT_DARK.
A pair of circular cardboard ear-bolt assemblies on the helmet sides: dark round backing discs, lighter hubs, and four little square fasteners around each hub.
A small raised cardboard robot face glyph centered on the visor: a gold pixel-style smile and two tiny square signal marks, leaving the main dark visor readable.
Deep blocky boot tread details on both feet: three transverse rubber strips, a lighter toe cap, and one folded cardboard heel tab per boot.
Two short exposed cardboard-and-string cables running from the chest plate toward the left shoulder, with square anchor blocks and a red connector.

Paint subtle horizontal corrugated cardboard grain across the torso, chest plate, and shoulder boxes using KRAFT, KRAFT_LIGHT, and KRAFT_HIGHLIGHT. Keep it sparse, handmade, and aligned with each panel.
Add a flat cardboard craft texture to the helmet: slightly lighter top planes, darker folded edges, a few soft scuffs, and tiny irregular tape patches in KRAFT_LIGHT and KRAFT_DARK.
Paint matching folded seams and small hand-drawn registration marks on both leg shells and arm shells in EDGE, KRAFT_HIGHLIGHT, and RED. Do not obscure the joints or silhouette.
